annotation.title_clean: 北京市无人驾驶航空器管理若干规定
annotation.title_en: Beijing Municipal Provisions on the Management of Unmanned Aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 北京市人民代表大会常务委员会
named_instruments_referenced: 中华人民共和国民用航空法
中华人民共和国反恐怖主义法
无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例
annotation.summary_en: Beijing municipal regulation declaring the whole city controlled airspace for unmanned aircraft. It bans flying, possessing, storing, transporting, selling and renting drones and core components, with exceptions for counter-terrorism, disaster relief, research, production and agriculture under police safety assessment. Penalties include confiscation and fines. Effective 15 November 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Entire Beijing municipality is controlled airspace; drone flights are prohibited.
Possessing, storing, transporting, selling or renting drones and core components is banned.
Special-protection exceptions for counter-terrorism, disaster relief, schools, research, production and agriculture after police safety assessment.
Fines of 500 to 100,000 yuan plus confiscation; e-commerce operators must enforce the sales ban.
Takes effect 15 November 2026; informants are rewarded.
